      public HeroView(Hero hero, ImageLoader imagesHero, ImageLoader imagesItems, ImageLoader imagesStatus)
      Creates a view for the hero with images and backpack.
      Parameters:
      hero - the hero to show
      imagesHero - the images of the hero
      imagesItems - the images of items for the backpack
      imagesStatus - the images for hero status effects

    • heroStat

      public void heroStat(Graphics2D graphics, com.github.forax.zen.ApplicationContext context)
      Draws all hero statistics on the screen. It sets the font and color, shows life, energy, mana, level, penalties, and gold, then restores old settings.
      Parameters:
      graphics - the graphics used to draw
      context - the application context with screen info

    • importHeroImage

      public void importHeroImage(Graphics2D graphics, com.github.forax.zen.ApplicationContext context)
      Draws the hero image on the screen. The position is based on the screen size.
      Parameters:
      graphics - the graphics used to draw
      context - the application context with screen info
